methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
This paper discusses 
a model driven approach integrating IT 
systems at design, construction and operation stages of buildings so that monitoring, analysis and optimization 
of building energy performance can be achieved.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Tool/system architecture without an identifiable or characterised EnPI/EnB measurement model.

The proposed system architecture (See Figure 1

Data Layer, (2) Information Layer, and (3) Tool Layer.
